# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 97 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 97 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_097_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9 — Angels, Ministry, and the Perfect Stones

**1** "All of these," he said, "are magnificent angels who surround the Lord. But the gate is the Son of God — the one and only entrance to the Lord. **2** No one reaches the Lord except through him. Don't imagine there's any other route than through the Son." **3** "I understand, Lord," I said. "But who were the six men carrying the stones?" **4** "These are the six holy angels of God who oversee all the virtues — the first things God ever created. The Lord has entrusted the entire created order to their care, to nurture and develop it. Through these six angels the tower reaches completion." **5** "And who are the others bringing stones?" **6** "They are also holy angels of the Lord — but the six are their superiors. When the tower is fully built, all of them will celebrate together in the presence of the Lord. **7** They will share the Lord's joy at the tower's completion." **8** "Lord," I said, "I'd like to understand what the stones represent." **9** "The perfect square white stones that fit together seamlessly — these are the apostles, bishops, teachers, and deacons: people who walked in God's holiness, who led and taught and served God's chosen people with purity and reverence. **10** Some of them have already died; others are still alive. They always agreed with one another and lived at peace with each other. That's why they fit together so perfectly in the tower — there are no gaps between them."

---

*PNEUMA renders the four-fold ministry clearly and translates the perfect-fit metaphor as an image of community harmony and theological unity.*
